workarounds.note: each number is fenced after its line and lifted back onto it by a top padding of minus one line (LEAD). Fenced before its line, the number of a line that opens a page slid up beside the last line of the page before: a side box fenced when the text column is full slides up the side column instead of waiting for the next page
level 1 restates breakBefore with parity 'odd', because a headings object drops it (gotcha headings-drop-h1-break)
the notes' heading style sets its own breakBefore with parity 'any': inheriting level 1's 'odd', the notes waited for page 9 behind a blank page 8 (gotcha style-inherits-break)

level 1 spans the page so that the laurel, anchored to the page's top-right corner, is painted above the text block; kept in the column, the design is clipped at the column's top edge, 21 mm below the trim

the laurel is an image element and reserves no height (gotcha opener-image-no-reserve): the kicker, title and headnote below it reach down the 20 lines the opener takes, and minHeight, a floor at the same depth, keeps the verse on line 21 when the headnote is shorter
col() writes the hex beside each paletteId, because 1.4.1 paints design slots (the kicker, both titles, the headnote, the running heads and the folios) from the hex (gotcha palette-skips-designs)
the titles and the headnote take lineHeight as a multiple of their size (1, 13 / 9.5), never a dimension (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)

the headnote is design text, which has no inline italics (gotcha design-text-no-inline-marks), so it cannot set Chester and Irish apart as 1645 does; the whole headnote is italic and the note on the text claims the 1645 italic of names for the poem only
short lines take a style of their own (firstLineIndent 2 em) instead of the verse style with its hangingIndent: one paragraph style cannot indent a line and also hang its turnover

verse and notes are ragged, and 1.4.1 never hyphenates ragged text (gotcha ragged-no-hyphenation): the verse needs no hyphenation setting, and the rag of the notes was read on the capture. If ragged text starts to hyphenate, give the verse style hyphenation: false
the notes are ragged, and 1.4.1 runs no runt check on ragged text: their last lines were read on the capture and reworded where one word stood alone
